name: Balm Bomb

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance

text: You can incorporate healing elixirs into your alchemical bombs as submunitions. As part of Quick Alchemy to create the bomb, you expend a second versatile vial to create a common alchemical elixir with the healing trait that you could create with Quick Alchemy. If you succeed at a Strike with the bomb, a willing ally within 5 feet of the target gains the benefits of activating the elixir and is temporarily immune to splash damage from the bomb for that Strike.
